svg.aria-label: Kernel polynomial method on a 200-site ring: Chebyshev polynomials, and the density of states from 20 and 100 moments with the Jackson kernel compared with the exact eigenvalue histogram and an undamped expansion that rings.
svg.text: KPM density of states for a 200-site tight-binding ring (computed for this figure)
van Hove peaks at band edges ±2 sharpen as M grows; validated moments 3.5e-15, DOS L2 1.7e-14
